about: ELIOS camera-calibration ground truth (simulation). Run the same G-code on the real arm, detect the same tag at each M240 and compare capture by capture.

frames.base: arm base, mm; Z up, arm faces -Y at home
frames.cal: arm1 = base rotated by theta1 about Z (the camera rides on arm1)
frames.cam: OpenCV: x right, y down, z forward, mm
frames.pixels: (row, col), origin at the centre of the top-left pixel

tag.link: arm5 bottom face (hand, after J4 pitch and J5 roll)
tag.corner_order: TL, TR, BR, BL as the detector reads the tag

meta.frame: arm1 = base rotated by theta1 about Z; p_cal = Rz(-theta1) p_base

gcode.text:
; ELIOS startup camera calibration · AprilTag on the hand
; Target: tag36h11 id 0 on the hand's bottom face (moves with J4 pitch and
; J5 roll), print 30 mm, black square 18.52 mm. The wrist pitches up (A) to
; show it to the camera. M240 = capture a camera frame here.
G21 G90 G17            ; mm, absolute, XY arc plane
G1 X0 Y-42.5 Z90 A0 B0 F600   ; initial pose, level wrist, no roll

; Depth 1 · wrist Y-100, tag ~100-117 mm from the lens
G1 Y-100 Z110 A20 F600 ; out and up, pitching the tag toward the camera
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 B30
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z150 B0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z110 A40 B60
G4 P400
M240

; Depth 2 · wrist Y-120, tag ~120-134 mm
G1 Y-120 Z90 B30
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z110 B0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 A20
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z150
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 B60 F400       ; roll rides the move, <= 20 deg/s
G4 P400
M240

; Depth 3 · wrist Y-140, tag ~141-151 mm
G1 Y-140 Z150 B30 F600
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 B0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z110 B30
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z90 A40 B0
G4 P400
M240

; Depth 4 · wrist Y-160, tag ~158-169 mm
G1 Y-160 B30
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z130 A20 B0
G4 P400
M240
G1 Z150 B30
G4 P400
M240

; Return: level the wrist on the way back, then the initial pose
G1 Y-100 Z110 A0 B0
G1 Y-42.5 Z90
M30
